configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: TRAINTRACKER_NO_DOTENV=1 TRAINTRACKER_DEMO=1 MAIL_BACKEND=console MCP_ACCOUNT_SECRET=local-preview-only HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=${PORT:-8000} DATABASE_URL=${PREVIEW_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/postgres} exec uv run traintracker serve-http

configurations.name: mcp-inspector
runtimeArgs: MCP_AUTO_OPEN_ENABLED=false exec npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@2 -e TRAINTRACKER_NO_DOTENV=1 -e TRAINTRACKER_DEMO=1 -e DATABASE_URL=${PREVIEW_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/postgres} uv run traintracker
